skill_name: Describe the steps involved in the facial recognition process.
workflow: The facial recognition process generally involves the following steps: preprocessing of the facial images, feature extraction, and classification. In the preprocessing step, images of faces are adjusted to minimize lighting differences, orientations, and scales, as well as remove any obscuring objects.
